entries.2540b46da045d198: This reportable segment is responsible for selling semiconductors and electronic components (integrated circuits and electronic devices), and is the larger of the two reportable segments by net sales. In addition to Macnica, Inc., subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Singapore, Taiwan, Thailand and elsewhere sell semiconductors and electronic components, and NAVYA MOBILITY SAS in France develops, manufactures and sells autonomous driving systems. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,040,045 million, up 18.2% from the prior year. In industrial equipment, overseas share expanded as the company gained new distribution flows centered on analog ICs, and net sales increased as the market itself recovered, centered on semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Domestic industrial equipment declined slightly, reflecting customer inventory adjustments in the first half of the fiscal year. Sales of AI servers for data centers increased, centered overseas, and computers rose sharply. In the automotive market, where the market itself stagnated, sales activities were well received and distribution flow transfers progressed.
entries.3bd8ef7a50854a70: This reportable segment sells network-related hardware, software, services and other products. Macnica, Inc. and Singapore's NETPOLEON SOLUTIONS PTE LTD sell network-related products. From the fiscal year ended March 2026, the former "Network Business" was renamed to its current name. The change affects only the name; the segment classification, scope and measurement method have not changed. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥174,150 million, up 13.1% from the prior year. In Japan, the scope of cybersecurity measures expanded among large companies, generating continued additional demand, and adoption spread to mid-sized and smaller companies; sales grew significantly, centered on endpoint security-related products. Solutions supporting secure content management in the cloud and SASE-related products, which integrate networking and security, were also solid, and overseas cybersecurity business, centered on Southeast Asia, is also growing.
